title: America’s Most Wanted vs. Triple X
summary: Chris Harris and James Storm clash with Triple X over tag-team supremacy. Their cage rivalry culminates with a stipulation that forces the losing team to split.

chapters.title: The first defining cage battle
chapters.result: America’s Most Wanted defeat Triple X in a cage to win the NWA tag titles.
chapters.context: The cage gives the young tag division a signature rivalry and raises the stakes beyond a routine championship exchange.

chapters.title: Six Sides of Steel ends a team
chapters.result: America’s Most Wanted defeat Daniels and Skipper; Triple X must disband.
chapters.context: Skipper’s cage-top tightrope walk becomes the match’s enduring image, but Harris and Storm win the showdown and the right to remain together.
